title: voacanga lanceolata
intro: Voacanga lanceolata, commonly known as the "Voacanga tree" or "Tabernanthe," is a tropical plant species native to West Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the ability to enhance mental clarity and reduce stress, possibly due to its anxiolytic and nootropic effects. The bioactive constituents of Voacanga lanceolata include indole alkaloids, such as voacangine and voacristine, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions are thought to be primarily attributed to its ability to modulate neurotransmitter activity and increase dopamine levels in the brain.
